title: SEVAL Query Set V2 (TSV)
description: Upload format: TSV file (matches SEVAL's QuerySet.fromTsv). The JSON Schema below describes the in-memory shape after CsvValidator converts each TSV row into a JSON object (the full file becomes a JSON array) — it is NOT the upload format. The 'query' TSV column contains a JSON-encoded array of user/bot message turns (multi-turn).

query.description: JSON array of user/bot message turns (V2 query schema, parsed from JSON in TSV column)

location.description: User location info (country, state, city, sourceType)

location_hints.description: Array of location hint objects with confidence scores and coordinates

chat_request_override.description: Override object for extending request fields (e.g., client_contexts)

botConversationId.description: Bot conversation identifier for multi-turn context

segment.description: Segment classification (maps to 'segment' or 'segment 2' TSV column)

annotation.description: CIQ annotation JSON associated with the utterance

tags.description: Comma-separated feature tags (e.g., CIQ, FRE, Sparkle prompt)

pluginOptions.description: Meeting IDs information, required for meeting copilot

plugins.description: Optional plugin configuration for Meeting Copilot

locationInfo.description: User location JSON for MChat localization

user_id.description: User email for per-query user override in MChat scraping

chat_request_override.description: JSON string for extending new columns (e.g., clientContexts)

plugin_response_overrides.description: JSON string for adding plugin responses into scraping options
